segments.sn23.2:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn23.2:1.4: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, sattoti vuccatī”ti?
segments.sn23.2:1.5: “Rūpe kho, rādha, yo chando yo rāgo yā nandī yā taṇhā, tatra satto, tatra visatto, tasmā sattoti vuccati.
segments.sn23.2:1.6: Vedanāya … saññāya … saṅkhāresu … viññāṇe yo chando yo rāgo yā nandī yā taṇhā, tatra satto, tatra visatto, tasmā sattoti vuccati”.
segments.sn23.2:2.1: “Seyyathāpi, rādha, kumārakā vā kumārikāyo vā paṃsvāgārakehi kīḷanti.
segments.sn23.2:2.2: Yāvakīvañca tesu paṃsvāgārakesu avigatarāgā honti avigatacchandā avigatapemā avigatapipāsā avigatapariḷāhā avigatataṇhā, tāva tāni paṃsvāgārakāni allīyanti keḷāyanti dhanāyanti [manāyanti (sī. pī. ka.)] mamāyanti.
segments.sn23.2:2.3: Yato ca kho, rādha, kumārakā vā kumārikāyo vā tesu paṃsvāgārakesu vigatarāgā honti vigatacchandā vigatapemā vigatapipāsā vigatapariḷāhā vigatataṇhā, atha kho tāni paṃsvāgārakāni hatthehi ca pādehi ca vikiranti vidhamanti viddhaṃsenti vikīḷaniyaṃ [vikīḷanikaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] karonti.
segments.sn23.2:2.4: Evameva kho, rādha, tumhepi rūpaṃ vikiratha vidhamatha viddhaṃsetha vikīḷaniyaṃ karotha taṇhākkhayāya paṭipajjatha.
segments.sn23.2:2.5: Vedanaṃ vikiratha vidhamatha viddhaṃsetha vikīḷaniyaṃ karotha taṇhākkhayāya paṭipajjatha.
segments.sn23.2:2.6: Saññaṃ … saṅkhāre vikiratha vidhamatha viddhaṃsetha vikīḷaniyaṃ karotha taṇhākkhayāya paṭipajjatha.
segments.sn23.2:2.8: Viññāṇaṃ vikiratha vidhamatha viddhaṃsetha vikīḷaniyaṃ karotha taṇhākkhayāya paṭipajjatha.

lines: Tatra satto tatra visattoti tatra laggo tatra vilaggo.
Mamāyantīti “mama idaṃ, mama idan”ti mamattaṃ karonti, aññassa phusitumpi na denti.
Vikīḷaniyaṃ karontīti “niṭṭhitā kīḷā”ti te bhindamānā kīḷāvigamaṃ karonti.
Pañcamādīsu catūsu cattāri saccāni kathitāni, dvīsu kilesappahānanti.
